Anthropic.description: An update on independent evaluators. Oct 15, 2026.Preparing for the 2026 US midterms. Earlier this year, we shared an update on our election safeguards. Here, we outline how we’ve continued to strengthen these safeguards ahead of this year’s US midterms.

Anthropic.description: "What does the current field of 2026 midterm candidates look like?" Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 4.6 triggered web search on these types of questions 92% and 95% of the time, respectively. These results show us that users asking about the midterms are consistently routed to up-to-date information.
